label: Binance halts AEUR after ~200% pump (~$3.25) day after listing
note: 2023-12-05: Binance halted AEUR after a ~200% pump to ~$3.25 just hours after listing. Only material event in AEUR's history.

label: Binance delists AEUR/USDT; remaining balances auto-convert to EUR from Aug 14
note: 2026-07-31: Binance ceased AEUR support, delisting the AEUR/USDT spot pair at 03:00 UTC after a July 30 notice. Users could convert AEUR to EUR 1:1 via Binance Convert until 2026-08-14 03:00 UTC; from then AEUR withdrawals were disabled and remaining balances auto-converted to EUR at 1:1.
